name: wedding-app
description: Self-hosted wedding venue platform - Fastify + SQLite + React

engines.//: Node 20 or 22 LTS. better-sqlite3 prebuilt binaries are LTS-only.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.audit: npm --prefix server audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix client audit --audit-level=high
scripts.audit:prod: npm --prefix server audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix client audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.ci: npm run audit && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:client && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run a11y
